newsitem.title: UK: Capital Corp may take itself private--paper.
newsitem.headline: Capital Corp may take itself private--paper.

text.p: British casino company Capital Corp has been mulling plans to take itself private in a deal worth about 200 million pounds ($321.7 million), the Sunday Telegraph reported.
The newspaper said Capital Corp had looked at plans for a leveraged buyout, which would probably be financed from venture capital sources.
Separately, the Observer on Sunday reported that Capital's investors were putting pressure on the company to disclose more details from internal probes into its gambling business.
Earlier this month, the British government blocked a hostile bid by London Clubs International Plc to take over Capital, citing competition concerns. ($ = 0.621 British Pounds)
